blocks.zh: 附錄1-3：法規標準、培訓程序與缺陷品處理
blocks.en: Appendices 1-3: Regulations and Standards, Training Procedures, and Defective Product Handling

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 識別單次使用系統（SUS）相關的主要國際標準、美國法規（21 CFR Part 211、USP <661>、USP <381>）及歐盟 GMP 要求，建立法規地圖
blocks.en: Identify the main international standards, US regulations (21 CFR Part 211, USP <661>, USP <381>) and EU GMP requirements that apply to single-use systems (SUS), and build a regulatory map

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 10993 系列生物相容性標準與 ISO 11137/11135 滅菌標準如何直接適用於 SUS 材料合格認證
blocks.en: Understand how the ISO 10993 biocompatibility series and the ISO 11137/11135 sterilization standards apply directly to the qualification of SUS materials

blocks.zh: 掌握 SUS 入庫檢驗程序的正確流程——從外箱完整性確認、照射標籤核對、到各類組件（袋子、管路、過濾器）的逐項目視檢查
blocks.en: Master the correct receiving inspection procedure for SUS, from checking outer carton integrity and verifying the irradiation label to item-by-item visual inspection of each component type (bags, tubing, filters)

blocks.zh: 了解缺陷品投訴流程：何時通報供應商、應提交哪些文件，以及根本原因分析（Root Cause Analysis）的調查邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the defective product complaint process: when to notify the supplier, which documents to submit, and the investigative logic of root cause analysis

blocks.zh: 掌握 SUS 使用中常見失效模式（以洩漏為主），並能對應各類風險的緩解措施，應用於 CDMO 無菌充填操作場景
blocks.en: Master the common failure modes of SUS in use (mainly leakage), match each risk to its mitigation measures, and apply them to CDMO aseptic filling operations

blocks.zh: 附錄 1 — Regulations and Standards（法規與標準）
blocks.en: Appendix 1 — Regulations and Standards

blocks.zh: 5.1 International Standards — ICH & ISO 5.1 國際標準 — ICH & ISO
blocks.en: 5.1 International Standards — ICH & ISO

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何 SUT 需要這麼多標準？
blocks.en: Core concept: why does SUT need so many standards?

blocks.zh: 單次使用系統（SUS）的特殊性在於它同時橫跨三個監管領域：製藥 GMP（ICH Q7/Q9/Q10）、醫療器材安全（ISO 10993 生物相容性系列）、以及滅菌技術（ISO 11135/11137）。這三個領域原本各自獨立，但 SUS 把它們強制整合在一起。
blocks.en: What makes single-use systems (SUS) special is that they span three regulatory domains at once: pharmaceutical GMP (ICH Q7/Q9/Q10), medical device safety (the ISO 10993 biocompatibility series), and sterilization technology (ISO 11135/11137). These three domains used to be independent, but SUS forces them together.

blocks.zh: 例如：一個拋棄式生物反應器袋需要同時符合——
blocks.en: For example, a disposable bioreactor bag must meet all of the following:

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-5（體外細胞毒性）：袋材不能傷害培養細胞
blocks.en: ISO 10993-5 (in vitro cytotoxicity): the bag material must not harm the cultured cells

blocks.zh: ISO 11137（輻射滅菌）：滅菌方法需確效
blocks.en: ISO 11137 (radiation sterilization): the sterilization method must be validated

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1（潔淨室）：製程環境需分類控制
blocks.en: ISO 14644-1 (cleanrooms): the process environment must be classified and controlled

blocks.zh: ICH Q9（品質風險管理）：整體風險評估框架
blocks.en: ICH Q9 (quality risk management): the overall risk assessment framework

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你要造一艘潛水艇，需要同時符合「機械工程標準」（ISO 9001結構強度）、「生命支援系統標準」（空氣品質）、以及「防腐蝕標準」（材料相容性）。SUS 就像這艘潛水艇——一個產品同時要面對多個主管機關和標準體系的要求。附錄 1 的用意就是幫你整理這張「標準地圖」，讓你知道哪個環節該查哪個文件。
blocks.en: Imagine building a submarine. It must meet "mechanical engineering standards" (ISO 9001 structural strength), "life support standards" (air quality), and "corrosion protection standards" (material compatibility) all at the same time. SUS is like that submarine: one product that has to satisfy several authorities and standards systems at once. The purpose of Appendix 1 is to lay out this "standards map" so you know which document to check for each aspect.

blocks.zh: ICH 系列在 SUT 中的角色
blocks.en: The role of the ICH series in SUT

blocks.zh: ICH Q9（品質風險管理） 是 SUS 整體風險管理的方法論基礎——所有關於浸出物 (leachables)、可萃取物 (extractables)、微粒的風險都必須在 ICH Q9 框架下進行評估。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) is the methodological basis for overall SUS risk management. All risks related to leachables, extractables and particulates must be assessed within the ICH Q9 framework.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10（製藥品質系統） 規定供應商管理、CAPA 系統、變更控制都需要整合進公司的品質體系——直接影響 SUS 供應商資格審核。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System) requires that supplier management, the CAPA system and change control be integrated into the company's quality system, which directly affects SUS supplier qualification.

blocks.zh: ICH Q3D（元素雜質） 也可能適用：若 SUS 材料含有特定金屬觸媒，需評估其是否溶入藥品造成元素雜質問題。
blocks.en: ICH Q3D (Elemental Impurities) may also apply: if a SUS material contains specific metal catalysts, you must assess whether they could dissolve into the drug product and cause an elemental impurity problem.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ISO 10993 系列最重要的子章節
blocks.en: Key point: the most important parts of ISO 10993

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 應用中，最常被引用的是：
blocks.en: In SUS applications, the parts most often cited are:

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1：總綱，規定評估策略——應先進行化學分析，再決定是否需要動物試驗
blocks.en: ISO 10993-1: the overarching standard that sets the evaluation strategy. Chemical analysis comes first, and only then is the need for animal testing decided.

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-5：體外細胞毒性——SUS 材料最基本的生物相容性門檻
blocks.en: ISO 10993-5: in vitro cytotoxicity, the most basic biocompatibility threshold for SUS materials

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-4：血液相容性——對接觸血液製品的 SUS 尤其重要
blocks.en: ISO 10993-4: hemocompatibility, especially important for SUS that contact blood products

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-11：全身毒性——通常通過萃取物/浸出物研究來滿足
blocks.en: ISO 10993-11: systemic toxicity, usually satisfied through extractables/leachables studies

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ISO 14644-1 潔淨室分類
blocks.en: Key point: ISO 14644-1 cleanroom classification

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1 的空氣潔淨度分類（ISO Class 5, 6, 7, 8）是製藥廠設計使用 SUS 環境的法規依據。無菌充填操作必須在 ISO Class 5（EU Grade A）環境進行，而 SUS 組裝通常在 ISO Class 7 或 8（EU Grade C/D）環境完成。了解這個分類系統有助於設計 SUS 開箱區域的環境控制要求。
blocks.en: The air cleanliness classes of ISO 14644-1 (ISO Class 5, 6, 7, 8) are the regulatory basis for designing the environments in which a pharmaceutical plant uses SUS. Aseptic filling must be performed in an ISO Class 5 (EU Grade A) environment, while SUS assembly is usually done in an ISO Class 7 or 8 (EU Grade C/D) environment. Understanding this classification system helps you define the environmental control requirements for SUS unpacking areas.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：建立 SUS 標準矩陣
blocks.en: CDMO application: building a SUS standards matrix

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌充填作業中，建議建立一張「SUS 適用標準矩陣」，針對每類 SUS（生物反應器袋、充填管路、過濾囊等），列出對應的 ISO 生物相容性要求、滅菌確效依據，以及潔淨室環境要求。這份矩陣在供應商資格審核 (SQA) 和法規送件時都會被要求提供。
blocks.en: For CDMO aseptic filling operations, we recommend building a "SUS applicable standards matrix" that lists, for each type of SUS (bioreactor bags, filling tubing, filter capsules, etc.), the relevant ISO biocompatibility requirements, the sterilization validation basis, and the cleanroom environment requirements. This matrix is requested during supplier quality assessment (SQA) and in regulatory submissions.

blocks.zh: 5.2 United States Regulations and Standards — FDA, AAMI, ASTM 5.2 美國法規與標準 — FDA, AAMI, ASTM
blocks.en: 5.2 United States Regulations and Standards — FDA, AAMI, ASTM

blocks.zh: 核心概念：21 CFR Part 211 對 SUS 的直接影響
blocks.en: Core concept: the direct impact of 21 CFR Part 211 on SUS

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211 是美國 FDA 針對成品藥的 GMP 規範，對 SUS 最相關的條文有兩條：
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 is the US FDA's GMP regulation for finished pharmaceuticals. Two of its provisions are most relevant to SUS:

blocks.zh: §211.65（設備結構）：要求製藥設備的接觸表面不得與藥品發生反應、增加成分或吸附——SUS 塑膠材料的浸出物研究正是為了符合這項要求。
blocks.en: §211.65 (Equipment construction): requires that product-contact surfaces of equipment must not be reactive, additive or absorptive. E&L studies on SUS plastics exist precisely to meet this requirement.

blocks.zh: §211.94（容器和密封件）：要求藥品容器和密封件不得與藥品發生反應、增加成分或吸附到足以影響藥品安全或效價的程度——直接規範了 SUS 袋材和接頭的 E&L 要求。
blocks.en: §211.94 (Drug product containers and closures): requires that drug product containers and closures must not be reactive, additive or absorptive to the extent that they alter the safety or potency of the drug. This directly governs the E&L requirements for SUS bag materials and connectors.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR §211.65 就像食品法規中規定「食品容器不得含有對人體有害的物質」。對不鏽鋼容器來說，這很容易做到；但對 SUS 塑膠袋來說，每批料號的配方可能不同，你必須用科學數據（E&L 研究）來「證明」它是安全的——而不是只靠材質宣稱。
blocks.en: 21 CFR §211.65 is like a food regulation stating that "food containers must not contain substances harmful to humans." For a stainless steel vessel this is easy to meet. For a SUS plastic bag, however, the formulation may differ from lot to lot, so you must use scientific data (E&L studies) to "prove" it is safe, rather than relying on a material claim alone.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ASTM E3051 — SUS 專屬標準
blocks.en: Key point: ASTM E3051, the SUS-specific standard

blocks.zh: ASTM E3051-16 是目前業界針對 SUS 最直接的設計與確效指引，它規範了 SUS 的規格、設計、確效及應用，為 ASTM E2500（一般製藥系統確效）的 SUS 專屬延伸版本。在 SUS 確效計畫中，這個標準通常被列為主要參考文件之一，與 BPOG 指引並用。
blocks.en: ASTM E3051-16 is currently the most direct industry guide for SUS design and validation. It covers the specification, design, validation and application of SUS, and is the SUS-specific extension of ASTM E2500 (validation of pharmaceutical systems in general). In a SUS validation program, this standard is usually listed as one of the main reference documents and used together with the BPOG guidance.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 對 SUS 數位化的影響
blocks.en: The impact of 21 CFR Part 11 on SUS digitalization

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 規範電子記錄與電子簽名，在現代 SUS 操作環境中越來越重要——因為單次使用感測器（一次性壓力感測器、pH 感測器等）直接輸出數位數據到 DCS/SCADA 系統。這些系統必須符合 Part 11 要求，包括稽核追蹤（audit trail）、存取控制，以及確保電子記錄具備法規效力。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 governs electronic records and electronic signatures and is increasingly important in modern SUS operations, because single-use sensors (disposable pressure sensors, pH sensors, etc.) output digital data directly to DCS/SCADA systems. These systems must comply with Part 11, including audit trails, access controls, and ensuring that electronic records have regulatory standing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：容器密封完整性測試 (CCIT)
blocks.en: Key point: container closure integrity testing (CCIT)

blocks.zh: FDA 2008 年指引允許以容器密封完整性測試 (Container Closure Integrity Test) 取代無菌測試作為穩定性測試項目。這對使用 SUS 袋儲存中間體的廠商尤其重要——需要選擇適當的 CCIT 方法（如 ASTM F2338 真空衰減法、ASTM F2391 氦氣追蹤法）並確效，而不能僅依賴目視檢查。
blocks.en: The FDA's 2008 guidance allows container closure integrity testing (CCIT) to replace sterility testing as a stability test item. This is especially important for manufacturers who store intermediates in SUS bags. They need to select and validate an appropriate CCIT method (such as ASTM F2338 vacuum decay or ASTM F2391 helium tracer gas), and cannot rely on visual inspection alone.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：FDA 查廠常見問題
blocks.en: CDMO application: common FDA inspection questions

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時針對 SUS 常見的提問方向：
blocks.en: Typical lines of questioning on SUS during an FDA inspection:

blocks.zh: 你的 SUS 供應商是否經過正式稽核？稽核範圍是否涵蓋 §211.65 和 §211.94 相關的材料合格性資料？
blocks.en: Has your SUS supplier been formally audited? Does the audit scope cover material qualification data relevant to §211.65 and §211.94?

blocks.zh: 你如何確保每批 SUS 入料時，其 E&L profile 與確效時使用的相符？
blocks.en: How do you ensure that the E&L profile of each incoming SUS lot matches the one used in validation?

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 820（品質系統法規）對醫療器材的要求——部分 SUS 供應商本身受 QSR 管制，你是否了解這對其品質體系的含義？
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation) sets requirements for medical devices. Some SUS suppliers are themselves subject to the QSR. Do you understand what this means for their quality system?

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，負責 SUS 採購的人員是否清楚 21 CFR §211.94 對供應商 E&L 資料的要求？這個資訊是否已被納入供應商資格審核（SQA）清單？
blocks.en: At your site, do the people responsible for SUS purchasing know what 21 CFR §211.94 requires of supplier E&L data? Has this information been built into the supplier qualification (SQA) checklist?

blocks.zh: 你目前使用的 SUS 系統中，哪些組件含有一次性感測器？這些感測器的數位輸出是否已納入 21 CFR Part 11 稽核範圍？
blocks.en: Which components of the SUS you currently use contain single-use sensors? Has the digital output of these sensors been included in the scope of your 21 CFR Part 11 audits?

blocks.zh: 5.3 United States Pharmacopeia (USP) 5.3 美國藥典 (USP)
blocks.en: 5.3 United States Pharmacopeia (USP)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：USP <661> 系列 — 塑膠包材的法規基礎
blocks.en: Core concept: the USP <661> series, the regulatory basis for plastic packaging materials

blocks.zh: USP <661> 是 SUS 塑膠材料最重要的藥典標準，分為兩個子章節：
blocks.en: USP <661> is the most important pharmacopeial standard for SUS plastic materials and is divided into two subchapters:

blocks.zh: USP <661.1>（塑膠材料本身）：規定了塑膠材料的鑑別測試、物理化學測試，如熔融指數、密度、灰分、重金屬——是對「材料配方」的要求。
blocks.en: USP <661.1> (plastic materials themselves): specifies identification tests and physicochemical tests for plastic materials, such as melt index, density, ash and heavy metals. These are requirements on the "material formulation."

blocks.zh: USP <661.2>（塑膠包裝系統）：規定整個包裝系統（含加工後的袋體）的萃取測試——是對「成品組件」的要求。
blocks.en: USP <661.2> (plastic packaging systems): specifies extraction testing of the entire packaging system (including the processed bag). These are requirements on the "finished component."

blocks.zh: 這兩個章節共同構成對 SUS 袋材和連接件的系統性化學評估框架。
blocks.en: Together, these two chapters form a systematic chemical evaluation framework for SUS bag materials and connectors.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：USP <381> — 彈性密封件
blocks.en: Core concept: USP <381>, elastomeric closures

blocks.zh: USP <381> 專門針對注射用彈性密封件（橡膠/矽膠塞）的測試要求，包括：外觀、透明度、功能性（自密封性）、生物測試（細胞毒性、全身毒性）、化學測試（還原物質、重金屬等）。
blocks.en: USP <381> sets test requirements specifically for elastomeric closures for injections (rubber/silicone stoppers), including appearance, transparency, functionality (self-sealing), biological tests (cytotoxicity, systemic toxicity) and chemical tests (reducing substances, heavy metals, etc.).

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 中，矽膠管路接頭、橡膠隔膜 (septum) 等組件通常需要符合 USP <381> 要求，這也是供應商提供 CoC（批次確認書）時應包含的測試項目之一。
blocks.en: In SUS, components such as silicone tubing connectors and rubber septa generally need to meet USP <381>, and this is one of the test items a supplier's CoC (certificate of conformance) should include.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：可萃取物 vs. 浸出物
blocks.en: Analogy: extractables vs. leachables

blocks.zh: USP <1663> 和 <1664> 分別對應 Extractables（可萃取物）和 Leachables（浸出物），兩者常被混淆：
blocks.en: USP <1663> and <1664> address Extractables and Leachables respectively, two terms that are often confused:

blocks.zh: Extractables：用極端條件（強溶劑、高溫）把塑膠中所有可能釋出的化合物「逼出來」——是潛在風險的最大邊界，由供應商做。
blocks.en: Extractables: all compounds that could possibly be released from the plastic, forced out under extreme conditions (strong solvents, high temperature). This is the upper boundary of potential risk and is generated by the supplier.

blocks.zh: Leachables：在實際使用條件下真正溶入藥品的物質——是實際風險，由藥廠（終端用戶）做。
blocks.en: Leachables: substances that actually migrate into the drug product under real conditions of use. This is the actual risk and is determined by the drug manufacturer (the end user).

blocks.zh: 就像一個茶包的「可萃取物」是你把茶包丟進沸騰的酸液中萃取出的所有成分；「浸出物」是你用正常水溫泡茶 3 分鐘後喝到的那些成分。監管要求你管理的是你真正喝下去的那部分。
blocks.en: Think of a tea bag. Its "extractables" are everything you would pull out by dropping it into boiling acid; its "leachables" are what you actually drink after steeping it in normal-temperature water for 3 minutes. Regulators expect you to manage the part you actually drink.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：微粒標準 USP <787> vs. <788>
blocks.en: Key point: particulate standards USP <787> vs. <788>

blocks.zh: SUS 在使用過程中可能產生微粒（尤其是薄膜碎屑），因此微粒標準至關重要：
blocks.en: SUS can generate particulates during use (especially film fragments), so particulate standards are critical:

blocks.zh: USP <788>：適用於一般注射劑，限值較寬（≥10 μm 不超過 6,000 個/container）
blocks.en: USP <788>: applies to general injectables, with wider limits (no more than 6,000 particles per container at ≥10 μm)

blocks.zh: USP <787>：專為生物製劑蛋白質注射劑設計，限值更嚴格
blocks.en: USP <787>: designed for protein injections of biologics, with stricter limits

blocks.zh: USP <1787>：提供蛋白質注射劑亞可見微粒的方法論指引
blocks.en: USP <1787>: provides methodological guidance for subvisible particles in protein injections

blocks.zh: SUS 製程中若涉及生物製劑充填，USP <787> 是更嚴格的適用標準。
blocks.en: If a SUS process involves filling a biologic, USP <787> is the stricter standard that applies.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：USP 測試的實際執行分工
blocks.en: CDMO application: who actually performs the USP testing

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 實務中，USP 測試的執行分工通常如下：
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, responsibility for USP testing is usually divided as follows:

blocks.zh: 供應商責任：提供 USP <661.1> 材料測試、USP <87>/<88> 生物反應性資料、USP <381> 密封件測試（含於 DMF 或 CoC）
blocks.en: Supplier responsibility: provides USP <661.1> material test data, USP <87>/<88> biological reactivity data, and USP <381> closure test data (included in the DMF or CoC)

blocks.zh: 藥廠/CDMO 責任：執行 USP <1663>/<1664> E&L 研究（或委外）、USP <788> 成品微粒測試、USP <1207> 容器密封完整性評估
blocks.en: Drug manufacturer/CDMO responsibility: performs the USP <1663>/<1664> E&L studies (or outsources them), USP <788> finished product particulate testing, and USP <1207> container closure integrity assessment

blocks.zh: 共同責任：USP <85> 內毒素測試——供應商提供 SUS 的 BET 限值規格，藥廠執行成品測試
blocks.en: Shared responsibility: USP <85> endotoxin testing. The supplier provides the BET limit specification for the SUS, and the drug manufacturer performs finished product testing.

blocks.zh: 你的供應商資格審核 (SQA) 問卷中，是否包含詢問 USP <661.1>/<661.2> 測試資料的項目？若不包含，你認為應如何修訂？
blocks.en: Does your supplier qualification (SQA) questionnaire include items asking for USP <661.1>/<661.2> test data? If not, how do you think it should be revised?

blocks.zh: 若你的 CDMO 客戶要求提供使用 SUS 製程的 E&L 研究報告，你需要整合哪些 USP 章節的數據？
blocks.en: If your CDMO client asks for an E&L study report for a process that uses SUS, which USP chapters will you need to draw data from?

blocks.zh: 5.4 European Standards and Regulations 5.4 歐洲標準與法規
blocks.en: 5.4 European Standards and Regulations

blocks.zh: 核心概念：EU GMP Annex 1 與 SUS 的關係
blocks.en: Core concept: EU GMP Annex 1 and SUS

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（無菌藥品製造） 在 2022 年大幅修訂後，正式納入了對 SUS 的明確要求。主要影響點包括：
blocks.en: After its major revision in 2022, EU GMP Annex 1 (Manufacture of Sterile Medicinal Products) formally includes explicit requirements for SUS. The main impacts are:

blocks.zh: SUS 供應商必須被視為關鍵物料供應商，需進行定期現場稽核
blocks.en: SUS suppliers must be treated as critical material suppliers and audited on site on a regular basis

blocks.zh: SUS 的完整性測試要求——進料後必須執行，不能只靠供應商 CoC
blocks.en: Integrity testing requirements for SUS: testing must be performed after receipt and cannot rely on the supplier's CoC alone

blocks.zh: 污染控制策略 (CCS) 中需要明確評估 SUS 帶來的微生物和微粒風險
blocks.en: The contamination control strategy (CCS) must explicitly assess the microbial and particulate risks introduced by SUS

blocks.zh: SUS 的使用必須有書面的風險評估，涵蓋浸出物對產品的影響
blocks.en: The use of SUS must be supported by a documented risk assessment that covers the impact of leachables on the product

blocks.zh: 核心概念：EP 3.1 系列 vs. USP <661> 系列比較
blocks.en: Core concept: comparing the EP 3.1 series with the USP <661> series

blocks.zh: EP 3.1 系列和 USP <661> 系列都是針對塑膠容器材料的藥典標準，但方法論有所差異：
blocks.en: The EP 3.1 series and the USP <661> series are both pharmacopeial standards for plastic container materials, but their methodologies differ:

blocks.zh: EP 3.1：以特定聚合物分類（PE、PP、EVA、矽橡膠等）分別規定測試——偏向「材料類別」管理
blocks.en: EP 3.1: specifies tests separately by polymer class (PE, PP, EVA, silicone rubber, etc.), which favors management by "material category"

blocks.zh: USP <661>：不依材料分類，而是用統一的系統性方法評估所有塑膠包材——偏向「性能」管理
blocks.en: USP <661>: does not classify by material but uses one systematic approach to evaluate all plastic packaging materials, which favors management by "performance"

blocks.zh: 出口歐盟的產品需符合 EP 3.1；出口美國則需符合 USP <661>。若要同時兼顧，需執行雙套測試或確認兩者的可互認性。
blocks.en: Products exported to the EU must meet EP 3.1; products exported to the US must meet USP <661>. To cover both, you must either run both sets of tests or confirm that the two are mutually recognizable.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：REACH 法規對 SUS 的影響
blocks.en: Key point: the impact of REACH on SUS

blocks.zh: REACH（EC No. 1907/2006） 是歐盟化學品管理法規，要求製造商/進口商對化學物質的安全使用承擔責任。對 SUS 的影響：
blocks.en: REACH (EC No. 1907/2006) is the EU chemicals regulation. It makes manufacturers and importers responsible for the safe use of chemical substances. Its impact on SUS:

blocks.zh: SUS 材料中不得含有 SVHC（高度關注物質）超過 0.1 wt%，否則需主動通知客戶
blocks.en: SUS materials must not contain more than 0.1 wt% of any SVHC (substance of very high concern); otherwise customers must be notified proactively

blocks.zh: 供應商須提供 REACH 合規聲明（SDS/Declaration of Conformity）
blocks.en: Suppliers must provide a REACH compliance statement (SDS/Declaration of Conformity)

blocks.zh: 在稽核 SUS 供應商時，REACH 合規文件是必查項目之一
blocks.en: When auditing a SUS supplier, REACH compliance documents are one of the items that must be checked

blocks.zh: 重點提示：EP 3.1.9 矽橡膠 — SUS 最常用的彈性體
blocks.en: Key point: EP 3.1.9 silicone elastomers, the most commonly used elastomer in SUS

blocks.zh: EP 3.1.9 規範矽膠彈性體用於瓶塞和管路的要求，包括外觀、化學測試（pH、氧化還原物質、泡沫能力）、生物測試（急性全身毒性試驗）。矽膠管路是 SUS 中最廣泛使用的組件，其 EP 3.1.9 合規性資料應包含在供應商 DMF 或技術文件包中。
blocks.en: EP 3.1.9 sets requirements for silicone elastomers used in stoppers and tubing, including appearance, chemical tests (pH, oxidizable substances, foaming ability) and biological tests (acute systemic toxicity test). Silicone tubing is the most widely used component in SUS, and its EP 3.1.9 compliance data should be included in the supplier's DMF or technical document package.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：全球法規地圖
blocks.en: Analogy: the global regulatory map

blocks.zh: 想像 SUS 供應商是一家跨國餐廳連鎖，需要同時符合美國 FDA（菜單標示法）、歐盟 REACH（食材安全法）、歐盟 GMP Annex 1（廚房衛生標準）、以及各國藥典（食譜配方要求）。每個市場有自己的規則，但核心原則相同：材料安全、製程可控、有文件可查。CDMO 在選擇 SUS 供應商時，需確認供應商能提供覆蓋主要目標市場的合規資料包。
blocks.en: Imagine a SUS supplier as a multinational restaurant chain that must comply with US FDA (menu labeling law), EU REACH (ingredient safety law), EU GMP Annex 1 (kitchen hygiene standards) and national pharmacopeias (recipe requirements) all at once. Every market has its own rules, but the core principles are the same: safe materials, controlled processes, and documentation you can check. When selecting a SUS supplier, a CDMO needs to confirm that the supplier can provide a compliance data package covering the main target markets.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：多市場法規合規策略
blocks.en: CDMO application: multi-market regulatory compliance strategy

blocks.zh: 對於同時服務美國、歐盟、日本客戶的 CDMO，SUS 的法規合規策略建議：
blocks.en: For a CDMO serving US, EU and Japanese clients at the same time, the recommended SUS regulatory compliance strategy is:

blocks.zh: 要求供應商提供 全球法規合規聲明，涵蓋 FDA（21 CFR）、EU（REACH + EP）、日本藥典
blocks.en: Require the supplier to provide a global regulatory compliance statement covering the FDA (21 CFR), the EU (REACH + EP) and the Japanese Pharmacopoeia

blocks.zh: 建立 SUS 材料資料庫，標記每個組件的法規覆蓋範圍
blocks.en: Build a SUS materials database that records the regulatory coverage of each component

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 採購合約中明確要求供應商在法規變更時主動通知，並納入變更控制程序
blocks.en: State explicitly in SUS purchase contracts that the supplier must notify you proactively when regulations change, and bring this into the change control procedure

blocks.zh: 附錄 2 — Example Training Procedures for Inspections（培訓與目視檢驗程序範例）
blocks.en: Appendix 2 — Example Training Procedures for Inspections

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUS 培訓程序為何需要標準化？
blocks.en: Core concept: why do SUS training procedures need to be standardized?

blocks.zh: SUS 的目視檢查不同於傳統設備的點檢——它是在每次使用前執行的一次性評估，且每次使用的 SUS 都是新品。這意味著：
blocks.en: Visual inspection of SUS is different from a routine check of conventional equipment. It is a one-time assessment performed before every use, and every SUS is brand new. This means that:

blocks.zh: 操作員每次都在「新品」上執行檢查，不像傳統設備那樣有使用狀態的基準對照
blocks.en: Operators perform the inspection on a "new" item each time, with no baseline of in-use condition to compare against, as there would be with conventional equipment

blocks.zh: SUS 的缺陷可能在開箱前就存在（運輸損傷），也可能在安裝過程中發生
blocks.en: SUS defects may already exist before unpacking (transport damage) or may occur during installation

blocks.zh: 若缺陷未被發現，後果可能是製程污染或批次損失，在無菌充填中更可能導致無菌批次失敗
blocks.en: If a defect goes undetected, the consequence may be process contamination or batch loss, and in aseptic filling it may even lead to a failed sterile batch

blocks.zh: 因此，培訓程序必須讓操作員能夠系統性地辨識正常狀態與異常狀態的差異。
blocks.en: Training procedures must therefore enable operators to systematically recognize the difference between normal and abnormal conditions.

blocks.zh: SUS 的入庫檢驗程序，就像飛行員在每次起飛前執行的「飛行前檢查清單」（Pre-flight Checklist）。即使是同一架飛機，每次起飛前都必須重新檢查。SUS 亦同——雖然同批次的產品設計相同，但每個個體都可能在運輸過程中受損。標準化的程序確保沒有步驟被跳過，即使操作員已有豐富經驗。
blocks.en: The SUS receiving inspection procedure is like the "pre-flight checklist" a pilot runs before every takeoff. Even for the same aircraft, the check must be repeated before every flight. The same applies to SUS: products from the same lot share the same design, but each individual unit may have been damaged in transit. A standardized procedure ensures that no step is skipped, even by experienced operators.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：照射標籤的重要性
blocks.en: Key point: the importance of the irradiation label

blocks.zh: 照射標籤（Irradiation Label） 是 SUS 最關鍵的目視確認項目之一。這個標籤在受到正確劑量的 Gamma 射線或電子束照射後會變色（通常從黃色變為紅色/橙色）。若標籤未變色，表示 SUS 可能未被正確滅菌，不得使用。另一個需確認的是過外包裝（over-pouch）是否維持輕微負壓（slight vacuum）——這是包裝完整性的即時指示器，若袋子已不呈現負壓狀態，表示包裝可能已被破壞。
blocks.en: The irradiation label is one of the most critical visual checks for SUS. After exposure to the correct dose of gamma or electron beam radiation, the label changes color (usually from yellow to red/orange). If the label has not changed color, the SUS may not have been properly sterilized and must not be used. Another item to confirm is whether the over-pouch still holds a slight vacuum. This is a real-time indicator of packaging integrity, and if the bag no longer shows a vacuum, the packaging may have been breached.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：分組件檢驗邏輯
blocks.en: Core concept: inspection logic by component group

blocks.zh: ISPE SUT 指引建議按「組件群組」而非「SUS 整體」進行檢驗，原因在於：
blocks.en: The ISPE SUT guide recommends inspecting by "component group" rather than by "the SUS as a whole", for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 不同組件的失效模式不同（袋膜關注撕裂，管路關注扭折，過濾器關注外殼損傷）
blocks.en: Different components have different failure modes (film: tears; tubing: kinks; filters: housing damage)

blocks.zh: 組件群組化後，可針對每類組件制定具體的合格/不合格判定標準
blocks.en: Once components are grouped, specific accept/reject criteria can be set for each type

blocks.zh: 方便追蹤：若後續發現異常，能快速縮小範圍到特定組件群組
blocks.en: It aids traceability: if an abnormality is found later, the search can quickly be narrowed to a specific component group

blocks.zh: 五大組件群組：外包裝 → 袋體 → 容器硬件系統 → 管路/接頭 → 過濾器/感測器。
blocks.en: The five component groups: outer packaging → bag → container hardware system → tubing/connectors → filters/sensors.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：儲存條件的法規意涵
blocks.en: Key point: the regulatory implications of storage conditions

blocks.zh: SUS 的儲存條件不只是「不要壓壞」的問題——供應商提供的儲存建議（溫度、濕度、避光等）是確效依據的一部分。若實際儲存條件超出供應商規定範圍（例如夏天倉庫溫度過高），這可能使供應商的保質期承諾失效，進而使整批 SUS 的品質保證依據動搖。因此，儲存條件監控記錄是 SUS 管理的重要 GMP 文件。
blocks.en: SUS storage conditions are not just a matter of "don't crush it." The storage recommendations from the supplier (temperature, humidity, light protection, etc.) are part of the validation basis. If actual storage conditions go outside the supplier's specified range (for example, a warehouse that gets too hot in summer), the supplier's shelf-life commitment may no longer hold, undermining the quality assurance basis for the whole lot of SUS. Storage condition monitoring records are therefore an important GMP document in SUS management.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：SUS 目視檢查 SOP 建立指引
blocks.en: CDMO application: guidance for building a SUS visual inspection SOP

blocks.zh: 在建立或更新 SUS 目視檢查 SOP 時，建議包含以下要素：
blocks.en: When creating or updating a SUS visual inspection SOP, we recommend including the following elements:

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：列出適用的 SUS 型號清單（不同型號的組件差異大，需個別規範）
blocks.en: Scope: list the SUS models covered (components differ greatly between models, so each needs its own specification)

blocks.zh: 參考文件：供應商的安裝和操作手冊 (IFU)、供應商培訓資料
blocks.en: Reference documents: the supplier's installation and operation manual (IFU) and supplier training materials

blocks.zh: 合格判定標準：每個組件群組的 Pass/Fail 判定基準，輔以實物照片（正常 vs. 不合格案例）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria: pass/fail criteria for each component group, supported by photographs (normal vs. rejected examples)

blocks.zh: 不合格處理：發現不合格品時的隔離、記錄、投訴程序（參照附錄 3 的缺陷品處理流程）
blocks.en: Handling of nonconforming product: quarantine, recording and complaint procedures when a nonconforming unit is found (see the defective product handling process in Appendix 3)

blocks.zh: 培訓記錄：操作員需完成 OJT（在職培訓）並有能力示範評估，培訓記錄需留存
blocks.en: Training records: operators must complete OJT (on-the-job training) and be able to demonstrate the assessment, and training records must be retained

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，SUS 開箱和目視檢查是由誰執行的（QC、操作員、還是兩者皆有）？如果發現照射標籤未變色，當前的 SOP 規定了哪些後續步驟？
blocks.en: At your site, who performs SUS unpacking and visual inspection (QC, operators, or both)? If the irradiation label has not changed color, what follow-up steps does your current SOP specify?

blocks.zh: 你的 SUS 暫存區是否有溫濕度監控？若有倉庫溫度超標事件，你如何評估受影響 SUS 的可用性？
blocks.en: Is the SUS staging area monitored for temperature and humidity? If a warehouse temperature excursion occurs, how do you assess whether the affected SUS are still usable?

blocks.zh: 附錄 3 — Defective Products and Failure Risks（缺陷品與失效風險）
blocks.en: Appendix 3 — Defective Products and Failure Risks

blocks.zh: 核心概念：供應商 CAPA 系統與終端用戶的連結
blocks.en: Core concept: the link between the supplier CAPA system and the end user

blocks.zh: 缺陷品（Defective Product） 的處理不是「退貨換貨」那麼簡單——它的核心是知識管理和品質改善的閉環。ISPE SUT 指引強調，即使不需要正式投訴，也建議通知供應商。原因有三：
blocks.en: Handling a defective product is not as simple as "return it and get a replacement." At its core it is a closed loop of knowledge management and quality improvement. The ISPE SUT guide stresses that even when no formal complaint is required, notifying the supplier is recommended, for three reasons:

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析 (Root Cause Analysis)：只有當供應商收到足夠的故障資訊，才能在工廠層面找到製造缺陷的源頭（原材料批次、生產設備、包裝程序等）
blocks.en: Root cause analysis: only when the supplier receives enough failure information can it trace the source of the manufacturing defect at the plant level (raw material lot, production equipment, packaging procedure, etc.)

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統支援：供應商的 CAPA 系統是製造品質的護欄——終端用戶的回饋是驅動其 CAPA 的重要輸入
blocks.en: Support for the CAPA system: the supplier's CAPA system is the guardrail for manufacturing quality, and end-user feedback is an important input that drives it

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析：單一事件可能是偶發，但多個終端用戶反映相同問題，才能識別系統性缺陷
blocks.en: Trend analysis: a single event may be a one-off, but when several end users report the same problem, a systemic defect can be identified

blocks.zh: SUS 缺陷品投訴流程就像航空業的「飛行員安全報告（ASRS）」制度。飛行員不一定每次都遭遇重大事故，但只要發現異常就會回報，讓航空公司和製造商能夠識別系統性問題、在重大事故發生前修正。SUS 也一樣——你的每一份投訴報告都在為這個行業的整體品質進步做貢獻。
blocks.en: The SUS defective product complaint process is like the aviation industry's pilot safety reporting system (ASRS). Pilots do not encounter a major accident every time, but they report anything abnormal, which lets airlines and manufacturers identify systemic problems and correct them before a major accident occurs. The same holds for SUS: each complaint report you file contributes to the quality improvement of the whole industry.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：退回缺陷品前必須完成的步驟
blocks.en: Key point: steps to complete before returning a defective product

blocks.zh: 退回缺陷品到供應商前，通常需要：
blocks.en: Before returning a defective product to the supplier, you will usually need to provide:

blocks.zh: 去污染證明（Certificate of Decontamination）：確認 SUS 已與危險物質（毒素、活病毒、細胞培養物）安全分離，保護供應商的接收和調查人員
blocks.en: Certificate of Decontamination: confirms that the SUS has been safely separated from hazardous substances (toxins, live virus, cell culture) to protect the supplier's receiving and investigation staff

blocks.zh: 完整包裝恢復：盡量將 SUS 恢復到原始接收狀態，包括外包裝——因為包裝與 SUS 的損傷位置相關性是根本原因分析的重要線索
blocks.en: Restored original packaging: return the SUS as close as possible to the condition in which it was received, including the outer packaging, because the correlation between packaging damage and SUS damage locations is an important clue in root cause analysis

blocks.zh: 批次文件：提供 SUS 的批號、使用記錄、製程條件等文件，供供應商調查使用
blocks.en: Batch documentation: provide the SUS lot number, usage records, process conditions and other documents for the supplier's investigation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUS 最常見的失效模式——洩漏（Leakage）
blocks.en: Core concept: the most common SUS failure mode, leakage

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出，SUS 在使用中的失效主要與洩漏相關（mostly related to leakages）。洩漏的主要來源包括：
blocks.en: The source text states explicitly that SUS failures in use are mostly related to leakages. The main sources of leakage include:

blocks.zh: 不當操作：儲存、轉移、安裝過程中造成薄膜損傷或焊接點受力
blocks.en: Improper handling: film damage or stress on welds during storage, transfer or installation

blocks.zh: 薄膜或焊接點的機械應力：過度折疊、超壓操作、不當的壓力/流速設定
blocks.en: Mechanical stress on film or welds: excessive folding, overpressure operation, and improper pressure or flow rate settings

blocks.zh: 這兩類失效模式的共同特點是：都可以通過良好的操作訓練和標準化程序來預防，而不需要依賴事後檢測。
blocks.en: What these two failure modes have in common is that both can be prevented by good operator training and standardized procedures, without relying on after-the-fact detection.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：無法退回缺陷品時的調查策略
blocks.en: Key point: investigation strategy when the defective product cannot be returned

blocks.zh: 當 SUS 接觸了毒素或活性生物（live virus vectors），無法物理退回時，調查只能依賴文件。這種情況下，建議採取以下措施：
blocks.en: When a SUS has contacted toxins or live biological agents (live virus vectors) and cannot be physically returned, the investigation can only rely on documents. In this case, we recommend the following measures:

blocks.zh: 在缺陷發現當下立即拍照/錄影（損傷位置、狀態、包裝狀態）
blocks.en: Take photos/videos immediately when the defect is found (damage location, condition, packaging condition)

blocks.zh: 保留使用前的目視檢查記錄（以確認損傷是在使用前還是使用中發生）
blocks.en: Keep the pre-use visual inspection records (to confirm whether the damage occurred before or during use)

blocks.zh: 保留批次製程數據（壓力、流速、時間記錄），作為操作條件的客觀依據
blocks.en: Keep the batch process data (pressure, flow rate and time records) as objective evidence of operating conditions

blocks.zh: 請供應商基於文件進行「桌面調查（Desktop Investigation）」，這在法規上是可接受的調查形式
blocks.en: Ask the supplier to conduct a "desktop investigation" based on the documents, which is an acceptable form of investigation from a regulatory standpoint

blocks.zh: 核心概念：供應商缺陷 vs. 操作缺陷的區分
blocks.en: Core concept: distinguishing supplier defects from handling defects

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析的第一步是區分缺陷是「供應商製造缺陷」還是「終端用戶操作缺陷」：
blocks.en: The first step in root cause analysis is to determine whether the defect is a "supplier manufacturing defect" or an "end-user handling defect":

blocks.zh: 供應商缺陷的跡象：組件缺失、組裝錯誤、包裝內異物、相同批次多個單位出現相同缺陷
blocks.en: Signs of a supplier defect: missing components, assembly errors, foreign matter inside the packaging, the same defect appearing in several units from the same lot

blocks.zh: 操作缺陷的跡象：損傷位置與操作手順有關聯性、新進人員使用時發生率較高、特定操作站點的損傷率偏高
blocks.en: Signs of a handling defect: damage location correlates with the operating sequence, higher incidence when new staff are involved, higher damage rates at particular workstations

blocks.zh: 包裝損傷與 SUS 損傷的位置相關性（correlation）是區分這兩類的關鍵線索——若兩者損傷位置吻合，暗示損傷在到廠前已發生（運輸損傷，屬供應商責任）。
blocks.en: The correlation between packaging damage and SUS damage locations is the key clue for telling the two apart. If the damage locations match, the damage probably occurred before arrival at the site (transport damage, which is the supplier's responsibility).

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：SUS 缺陷品管理程序建立
blocks.en: CDMO application: building a SUS defective product management procedure

blocks.zh: 建立 SUS 缺陷品管理程序時，CDMO 需考量以下特殊情境：
blocks.en: When building a SUS defective product management procedure, a CDMO needs to consider the following special situations:

blocks.zh: 客戶通知義務：若缺陷 SUS 已接觸客戶的藥品原料，需評估是否需啟動偏差調查並通知客戶
blocks.en: Customer notification obligation: if the defective SUS has contacted a customer's drug substance, you must assess whether to open a deviation investigation and notify the customer

blocks.zh: 批次影響評估：缺陷 SUS 可能造成批次污染（微粒、洩漏）或批次損失，需有明確的批次影響評估程序
blocks.en: Batch impact assessment: a defective SUS may cause batch contamination (particulates, leakage) or batch loss, so a clear batch impact assessment procedure is needed

blocks.zh: 供應商責任釐清：在投訴流程中需保留明確的時間軸文件（SUS 入廠時間、儲存條件、使用時間），以協助釐清責任歸屬
blocks.en: Clarifying supplier responsibility: the complaint process should preserve a clear timeline (SUS receipt date, storage conditions, time of use) to help establish where responsibility lies

blocks.zh: 趨勢報告：建立 SUS 缺陷品的追蹤資料庫，定期向供應商提交趨勢報告，推動其持續改善
blocks.en: Trend reports: set up a tracking database for SUS defective products and submit trend reports to the supplier regularly to drive its continual improvement

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠，目前是否有針對 SUS 缺陷品的正式投訴程序？當缺陷 SUS 已接觸製程物料時，你的投訴記錄中需要包含哪些安全資訊？
blocks.en: Does your site currently have a formal complaint procedure for defective SUS? When a defective SUS has already contacted process materials, what safety information must your complaint record include?

blocks.zh: 若連續出現三件相同型號 SUS 在相同位置（例如相同側面的管路焊接點）發生洩漏，你的根本原因分析會優先考慮哪些假設？你會如何設計調查計畫？
blocks.en: If three SUS of the same model leak at the same location (for example, the same side of a tubing weld), which hypotheses will your root cause analysis consider first? How would you design the investigation plan?

blocks.zh: 在無法退回缺陷品的情況下（例如接觸過活性病毒的 SUS），你的桌面調查需要收集哪些具體文件和數據？
blocks.en: When the defective product cannot be returned (for example, a SUS that has contacted live virus), which specific documents and data does your desktop investigation need to collect?

blocks.zh: 附錄 1–3 章節總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Appendix 1–3 Section Summary

blocks.zh: 法規地圖的建立：SUS 同時受 ICH（品質系統/風險管理）、ISO 10993（生物相容性）、ISO 11137/11135（滅菌確效）、21 CFR Part 211（美國 GMP）、EU GMP Annex 1（無菌製造）、以及各國藥典（USP、EP）的多重管轄，建立系統性的法規合規矩陣是 SUS 導入的必要前置作業。
blocks.en: Building the regulatory map: SUS falls under the combined jurisdiction of ICH (quality system/risk management), ISO 10993 (biocompatibility), ISO 11137/11135 (sterilization validation), 21 CFR Part 211 (US GMP), EU GMP Annex 1 (sterile manufacturing) and national pharmacopeias (USP, EP). Building a systematic regulatory compliance matrix is a necessary first step in adopting SUS.

blocks.zh: USP 雙軌標準：USP <661>/<661.1>/<661.2>（塑膠包材化學評估）與 USP <381>（彈性密封件）是最核心的藥典要求，配合 USP <1663>/<1664>（E&L 研究）構成完整的材料安全評估框架。
blocks.en: The USP dual-track standards: USP <661>/<661.1>/<661.2> (chemical evaluation of plastic packaging materials) and USP <381> (elastomeric closures) are the core pharmacopeial requirements. Together with USP <1663>/<1664> (E&L studies), they form a complete framework for material safety assessment.

blocks.zh: ASTM E3051 是 SUS 確效的主軸：作為第一部 SUS 專屬 ASTM 標準，它為製藥 SUS 的規格制定、設計確效、應用評估提供了統一的方法論基礎。
blocks.en: ASTM E3051 is the backbone of SUS validation: as the first SUS-specific ASTM standard, it gives a unified methodological basis for specification, design validation and application assessment of pharmaceutical SUS.

blocks.zh: 培訓程序的核心是系統化檢驗：SUS 的目視檢查應按五大組件群組（外包裝、袋體、容器硬件、管路/接頭、過濾器/感測器）進行，並需特別確認照射標籤和 over-pouch 真空狀態——這是每次使用前的最後一道品質閘口。
blocks.en: The core of the training procedure is systematic inspection: visual inspection of SUS should follow the five component groups (outer packaging, bag, container hardware, tubing/connectors, filters/sensors), with particular attention to confirming the irradiation label and the over-pouch vacuum. This is the last quality gate before each use.

blocks.zh: 缺陷品管理是主動品質工具：即使不強制投訴，也應主動通知供應商，利用其 CAPA 系統推動持續改善。完整的缺陷品文件（批號、製程記錄、照片、去污染證明）是根本原因分析的基礎；對於無法退回的缺陷品，桌面調查是可接受的替代方式。
blocks.en: Defective product management is a proactive quality tool: even where a complaint is not mandatory, notify the supplier proactively and use its CAPA system to drive continual improvement. Complete defect documentation (lot number, process records, photos, certificate of decontamination) is the basis for root cause analysis, and for defective products that cannot be returned, a desktop investigation is an acceptable alternative.

blocks.zh: 洩漏是 SUS 最常見的失效模式：主要來源是操作不當（儲存、搬運、安裝）和機械應力（過度折疊、超壓），兩者都可通過標準化 SOP 和操作訓練來顯著降低發生率，預防勝於事後追查。
blocks.en: Leakage is the most common SUS failure mode: the main sources are improper handling (storage, transport, installation) and mechanical stress (excessive folding, overpressure). Both can be significantly reduced through standardized SOPs and operator training, and prevention is better than tracing causes after the fact.
